title: Princess Dreamhouse Watercolor Cliparts
author: BLOSSOM.clipart
description:
This bundle of transparent PNG clipart is perfect for any project, and includes commercial use.
Welcome to Blossom.clipart – a truly authentic flower store that will help you create the most amazing art for all your seasonal projects.
❤ WHAT YOU WILL GET:
Zip file includes:
– PNG files
– 300 DPI, 4000×4000 pixel, sent as a finished file with transparent background.
❤HOW TO USE:
Can be printed at your home printer. Or take it to a print shop
The images are made for sublimation and other things (T-shirt, cards, mugs, pillows, wall clock, posters etc.)
In order to use for sublimation, you must have a sublimation printer and heat press.
Thank you for dropping by Blossom.
